data.name: Chitrangda
data.gender_notes: Chitrangda is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is skilled in painting, arts, and crafts. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘chitra’ meaning picture or painting and ‘angda’ meaning skilled or expert. The name Chitrangda carries the meaning “Skilled in painting” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chitrangda usually hope their child will grow to embody skilled in painting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for an artistic and creative soul, reflecting the divine essence of creativity.
data.etymology: Chitrangda belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Skilled in painting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chitrangda total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Chitrangda reflects the rich and diverse artistic heritage of Hindu culture. It is a reminder of a time when creating beautiful art, whether it was painting, sculpting, or crafting beautiful jewelry, was a deeply valued and integral part of life. This name also points to the importance of aesthetics and the role it plays in shaping our perception of the world around us.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Chitrangda is a testament to the creative energy that dwells within us all. It reminds us of the need to tap into our own inner artist and express ourselves creatively, whether through painting, poetry, music, or any other form of art. In a spiritual sense, this name encourages us to explore the hidden depths of our own consciousness and bring beauty and light into the world. Through our creative expression, we can connect with the divine and truly experience the wonders of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chitrangada signifies the radiant and resplendent one, adorned with the art of painting and poetry, thereby expressing creativity and aesthetic sensibilities. It is a name that embodies artistry, grace, and enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Chitrangada was a king of the Vakataka dynasty in the 5th century AD. The name Chitrangda carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Chitrangada was a powerful and influential ruler during the Vakataka period.

trends: The name Chitrangada is gaining popularity as a unique and beautiful name for boys.
Some people associate the name with the strength and power of the historical Chitrangada.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Chitrangda remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Priya Chitrangda from Delhi, India embodies the meaning of Chitrangda - "Skilled in painting". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
